description: Middle M1-M9 stack-grid BOM-sequence benchmarks. BOM count follows STACKS-style sequence starting at 6: 6,6,6,6,8,8,8,8,10. Per-BOM SKU type sequence: 10,14,18,22,7,10,14,18,22.
